NCT05912381.title: Phase III Pembrolizumab + Metformin Oncology Study
NCT05912381.condition: Advanced Solid Tumors / Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
NCT05912381.summary: Randomized phase III study evaluating the synergistic efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibition combined with metabolic modulation via metformin in refractory advanced oncology patients.

inclusion_criteria.description: Patient must be at least 18 years of age at the time of signing informed consent.
inclusion_criteria.rationale: Adult population required for oncology pharmacokinetic modeling.
Adequate renal clearance required to avoid lactic acidosis associated with metformin.

inclusion_criteria.description: Platelet count >= 100,000 / µL without transfusion support within 14 days.
inclusion_criteria.rationale: Sufficient bone marrow reserve required prior to immunotherapy initiation.
Ambulatory status and baseline functional capacity adequate for protocol interventions.

exclusion_criteria.rationale: Severe drug-drug interactions and uncontrolled bleeding hazard with trial agents.
Excessive glycemic dysregulation confounds metabolic study endpoints.

exclusion_criteria.description: Presence of active or untreated brain metastases.
exclusion_criteria.rationale: High risk of intracranial hemorrhage and neurotoxicity during immunotherapy.

NCT04192831.title: Phase II Diabetic Nephropathy SGLT2 Inhibitor Study
NCT04192831.condition: Diabetic Nephropathy / Stage 2-3 Chronic Kidney Disease
NCT04192831.summary: Placebo-controlled phase II trial investigating renal-protective and albuminuria-lowering effects of SGLT2 inhibition in patients with established diabetic kidney disease.

inclusion_criteria.rationale: Maturity of diabetic kidney disease presentation.
Moderate glycemic control to isolate nephroprotective effects.
Confirmed significant proteinuria indicating target diabetic nephropathy phenotype.

exclusion_criteria.description: Severe renal failure defined as eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73m².
exclusion_criteria.rationale: Blunted efficacy of SGLT2 inhibitors and heightened risk of acute kidney injury.
Substantial elevated risk of euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis with SGLT2 inhibitors.

exclusion_criteria.description: Documented prior history of Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA).
exclusion_criteria.rationale: High recurrence liability during SGLT2 inhibition regimen.
